title: flatnotes
name: flatnotes
description: Distraction-free notes app with no folders or database, just a folder of markdown files behind full-text search, tags, wikilinks and a raw or WYSIWYG editor. Source: https://github.com/dullage/flatnotes

env.name: FLATNOTES_PASSWORD
env.label: Password (required)
env.description: What you'll log in with. Anything long and hard to guess.

env.name: FLATNOTES_SECRET_KEY
env.label: Secret key (required)
env.description: Signs your logins. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

env.name: FLATNOTES_PORT
env.label: Host port for the web UI

note: Set the password and secret key before you deploy (openssl rand -hex 32 makes a good key), since the stack won't start without them. Then open http://<your-host>:8780 (or whichever port you picked) and log in with that username and password. It's one account, read fresh on every start, so changing the password here and redeploying changes it, and a new secret key just logs you out. Notes are plain .md files in the flatnotes-data volume, with uploads in its attachments folder and the search index in .flatnotes. Docs: github.com/dullage/flatnotes/wiki
